title: Restaurant Consulting Services for Operators | Monarch
description: Restaurant consulting services from one white-glove team: software, AI, staff training, marketing, furniture, and uniforms. Start with a free AI assessment.

hero.h1: Restaurant Consulting Services, From Software to Uniforms
hero.sub: Software, AI, staff training, marketing, scheduling, furniture, uniforms, operations, and multi-location rollouts from one white-glove team. We do the work. You guide the process.

sections.label: One Partner
sections.h2: Restaurant Consulting Services That Cover the Whole Operation
body: Our restaurant consulting services bring everything your restaurant runs on into one place: the software your team uses every shift, the training that gets new hires ready for the floor, the marketing that keeps covers coming, and the furniture and uniforms guests notice the moment they walk in.

Think of us as a restaurant business consultant who also builds. We start with a walkthrough, write a plan you approve, and then do the work. Choose one service or several, and every engagement is scoped to your restaurant.

sections.label: Systems and People
sections.sub: The tools and habits that carry service from pre-shift to close.

items.title: Staff Training and Custom LMS
items.text: A personal LMS for your restaurant with role-based academies, daily lessons, quizzes, trainer sign-offs, handbook e-signatures, menu training, and bilingual content.

items.title: Custom Restaurant Software
items.text: Guest apps, reservations, host stand, server tablets, kitchen displays, staff portals, and admin tools that run alongside your existing POS.

items.title: AI for Restaurants
items.text: AI assistants for operations evaluations, host and concierge help, server briefs, scheduling drafts, and marketing, with a person confirming anything that books, publishes, or sends.

items.title: Scheduling and Labor Planning
items.text: Staff schedules and labor plans built from your book, history, and staffing minimums, so you can protect margin before the week starts.

items.title: Operations Consulting
items.text: A close look at pacing, table turns, wait times, labor targets, prime cost, menu engineering, and SOPs, with AI operations evaluations and a plan to fix what we find.

items.title: Multi-Location Rollouts
items.text: One standard for software, training, uniforms, and marketing across every location, so each new opening matches the last.

sections.label: Guest-Facing
sections.sub: What guests see before they book, when they sit down, and every time a server walks up.

items.title: Restaurant Marketing
items.text: Websites, SEO, Google Business Profile, social, paid ads, email and SMS, reviews, launch campaigns, and press kits, built on your sales data.

items.title: Furniture and FF&E
items.text: Restaurant furniture and FF&E sourcing, from floor plan and table configuration to samples, ordering, freight, and install timing, with your designer and builders.

items.title: Uniform Programs
items.text: Role-based uniforms for front of house, back of house, bar, host, and valet, with sizing, logo work, new-hire kits, and reorders that match across locations.

sections.label: Lead Service
sections.h2: Training Is Where White Glove Shows Most
body: Most owners don't have time to write a training program, so we write it for you. We build the curriculum from your recipes, SOPs, and handbook, set it up as role-based academies in a personal LMS, and add menu training and bilingual content.
You review every lesson and approve it before a new hire logs in. See how restaurant staff training works.

sections.label: Vendor Network
sections.h2: Use Our Restaurant Vendors or Keep the Ones You Trust
body: Clients get access to our network of restaurant vendors. If you already have suppliers you like, we coordinate those relationships for you, from specs and samples to orders, timelines, and follow-ups.
Either way, one team keeps every vendor on the same schedule as your software, training, and opening date.

sections.h2: Find Out Which Services Your Restaurant Needs First

faq.q: How much do your restaurant consulting services cost?
faq.a: Every engagement is scoped to your restaurant. After the walkthrough, you get a written plan with priorities, budget, and timeline, and you approve it before anything starts.

faq.q: Do I have to use every service?
faq.a: No. You can start with one service, like a training academy or a marketing refresh, and add more when the timing's right. Your plan keeps everything pointed in the same direction.

faq.q: Can you work with the vendors I already have?
faq.a: Yes. You can use our vendor network, or we'll coordinate the vendor relationships you already have. Either way, we handle the specs, timelines, and follow-ups so your team can stay focused on service.

faq.q: Should I look for a restaurant consultant near me, or can you work remotely?
faq.a: We're based in Tampa Bay, Florida, and work with restaurants nationwide. The first walkthrough can happen on site or virtually, and your plan sets how we'll work together from there.

faq.q: How does your software work with my POS?
faq.a: It runs alongside your existing POS, so the way your team rings in orders doesn't have to change. We can also coordinate POS onboarding and hardware timing, and build POS lessons into your training academy.

faq.q: What do I need to provide?
faq.a: Time for the walkthrough and access to what you already have: recipes, SOPs, your handbook, menus, brand files, and vendor contacts. We do the writing and building, and you review and approve each round.
